sloka: तृप्तिर्न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मा ऽपि वने सत्वनिषेविते ।पुरा तु भिक्षमाणाय भिक्षा वै यतये नृप ।न हि दत्ता त्वयेन्द्राभ यस्मादतिथये ऽपि वै ।। ७.७८.१६ ।।
transliteration: tṛptirna te 'sti sūkṣmā 'pi vane satvaniṣevite ।purā tu bhikṣamāṇāya bhikṣā vai yataye nṛpa ।na hi dattā tvayendrābha yasmādatithaye 'pi vai ।। 7.78.16 ।।

translations.english: O King, even a little satisfaction is not yours in this forest inhabited by creatures, because formerly, O Indra-like one, you did not give alms to a begging ascetic, nor indeed to any guest.
